candidate_axiom.name: Quantum Superposition Demarcation & Decoherence Measurement
candidate_axiom.statement: Exploratory candidate trajectories may evolve in superposition across multiple parallel topologies until explicit measurement against target invariants collapses the wavefunction into stable pointer states.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Premature pruning of non-orthogonal architectural states before target interaction is prohibited.

leaderboard.name: Leibniz's Identity of Indiscernibles & Bisimulation
leaderboard.statement: Subsystems exhibiting identical observational behaviors across all operational contexts must be unified into a single canonical AST representation, eliminating superficial syntactical duplication.
leaderboard.formal_expression: \forall x, y \; (\forall P \; (P(x) \leftrightarrow P(y)) \implies x = y)
leaderboard.operational_rule: Components that are observationally bisimilar but syntactically separated are collapsed into single canonical primitives.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Subsystem A] ──┐
                 ├──> [Bisimulation Game Engine] ──> [Equivalence Quotient]
[Subsystem B] ──┘                                           │
                                                            ▼
                                                [Canonical Unified Module]

Bisimulation Game Engine.role: Tests behavioral equivalence across all admissible input sequences.
Bisimulation Game Engine.invariant_rule: Simulates step-by-step state matching between components.

Equivalence Quotient Collapser.role: Replaces observationally identical modules with a single shared instance.
Equivalence Quotient Collapser.invariant_rule: Guarantees zero divergence in compiled system outputs.

Indiscernibility Invariant Guard.role: Prevents redundant re-implementation of existing subsystem capabilities.
Indiscernibility Invariant Guard.invariant_rule: Rejects proposals that merely re-skin existing functions.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Forces generators to invent genuinely novel behaviors (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Quickly identifies duplicate proposals across epochs (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Drastically reduces codebase bloat and maintenance surface.
tradeoffs.constraints: Bisimulation checking is computationally intensive for complex state machines.

leaderboard.name: Active Inference & Variational Free Energy Minimization
leaderboard.statement: Subsystems must maintain generative models of their interface environments, executing state transitions that minimize variational free energy (divergence between anticipated and observed messages).
leaderboard.operational_rule: Passive reactive modules lacking internal predictive models are deprecated in favor of active inference agents.
leaderboard.principle: Free Energy Principle and Markov Blankets

system_profile.archetype: Generative Predictive State Filter & Active Invariant Regulator
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Internal Generative Model] ──> [Top-Down Prediction]
                                            │
                                            ▼
[External Ingress Stream]  ──> [Sensory Markov Blanket] ──> [Prediction Error (Free Energy)]
                                                                    │
                                                                    ▼
                                                        [Active State Transition]

Internal Generative Model.role: Maintains probabilistic expectations of future environmental messages.
Internal Generative Model.invariant_rule: Continuously updates prior distributions using sensory feedback.

Sensory Markov Blanket.role: Isolates internal states from external perturbations via formal boundary.
Sensory Markov Blanket.invariant_rule: Information exchange must pass exclusively through blanket states.

Free Energy Minimizer.role: Executes actions that resolve sensory prediction errors.
Free Energy Minimizer.invariant_rule: Minimizes variational upper bound on surprisal.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Introduces predictive cybernetics to distributed software (+0.0150).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Predicts component failures before RPC timeouts occur (+0.0160).

tradeoffs.strengths: Anticipates traffic spikes and faults proactively rather than reactively.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires internal model maintenance and probabilistic inference compute.
